meta.name: writing-guidelines
meta.description: Review docs/prose for Writing Guidelines compliance. Use when asked to "review my docs", "check writing style", "audit prose", "review docs voice and tone", or "check this page against the writing handbook".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查文档是否符合写作规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要确保文档遵循统一的写作指南
copy.tagline_en: Check docs for writing guidelines compliance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure docs follow a writing handbook

howto.what: Claude 会先从一个固定网址获取最新版写作规范，再读取你指定的文件，逐条核对后，用“文件名:行号”的格式列出所有不合规之处。
howto.when: 当你要求“review my docs”“check writing style”“audit prose”等，或说“检查这段文字是否符合写作手册”时触发。

say.text: 帮我 review 一下我的 docs，看看有没有违反写作规范
say.note: Claude 会先获取最新规范，再检查你的文档。

howto.what_en: Claude fetches the latest Writing Guidelines from a fixed URL, reads the specified files, checks them against every rule, and reports violations in file:line format.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to 'review my docs', 'check writing style', 'audit prose', or similar requests to review against the writing handbook.

say_en.text: Review my docs and check for writing guideline violations.
say_en.note: Claude fetches the latest guidelines and checks your docs.

say_en.text: Check writing style for these files: README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md.
say_en.note: Specify files; Claude reports issues by line number.

say_en.text: Audit prose in the current page against the writing handbook.
say_en.note: Claude fetches the handbook and checks for compliance.
